title: Neon Snake Deluxe
description: The arcade classic rebuilt with cyber-neon visuals, unlockable skins, exciting power-ups, combo streaks, and synthesized sound effects.
instructions: Steer your neon viper to collect glowing fruit and grow longer.
Chain consecutive fruit quickly to build massive Combo Multipliers (up to 5x!).
Snag rare power-ups: Golden Stars (+50 pts), Turbo Rush (2x speed & score), Ghost Mode (pass through walls/body), and Frost Chill (slow-mo).
Unlock dazzling snake skins (Synthwave, Solar Viper, Prism Flux) by beating high score milestones.
Switch between Classic, Zen (wall wrap), and Speed Rush modes anytime.
controls: Steer with Arrow Keys or W A S D on desktop keyboards
Swipe or tap the on-screen D-Pad on mobile devices
Press Space to instantly play, retry, or pause
Toggle sound and custom skins using the top header buttons
